lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Capitol Hill, 2148. Fallen columns, no roof, and a museum built in the ruin of the chamber by people who were paid to build it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every exhibit is accurate. There is a case for the Handover, a case for the Founding, and a nineteen-month gap between them with a card in it that says RECORDS INCOMPLETE.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: My grandmother came here on a school trip. She said it was the first time she understood that a building could lie to you politely.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: It isn't lying. That is the horrible part. Every word in here is true and the shape of it is a lie.
